description: This file defines the ExpiresParsingMiddleware class responsible for handling and logging failures in parsing the 'expires' header in AWS S3 responses. It provides middleware functionality to process commands and results, and logs warnings when expiration headers cannot be parsed correctly.

classes.name: ExpiresParsingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for parsing the 'expires' header in AWS S3 responses and logging warnings if parsing fails.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method returning a middleware handler function wrapping the next handler.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor accepting a callable handler to be invoked within the middleware.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, processing the command and optionally the request, and logs a warning if the 'expires' header fails to be parsed.
